subject: Re: Montclair Health — Private Pilot: calendar window & evidence checklist
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@montclairhealth.org>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.in>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.in>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private pilot request — Montclair Health

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick demo sign-up — we filled out the self-serve intake and would like to lock a pilot window for October 19–23. We have a few constraints to confirm before we finalize:

- This pilot must be inside our VPC/air-gapped environment; can Redwood provide an ops checklist for host prep?
- Our security team needs an initial SOC2/PCI evidence snapshot; I attached our standard questions to this thread.
- We have a mandatory stakeholder review with the CIO on Oct 22 (US/Eastern) and prefer the technical walkthrough earlier in the week.

Can you confirm who from Redwood will be on the call (solutions engineer + ops?) and whether there’s any pre-demo preflight we should complete?

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
IT Program Manager — Montclair Health
montclairhealth.org

Attachment: montclair-pci-soc2-questions.pdf (14 KB, PDF)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.in>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@montclairhealth.org>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.in>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.in>
Date: Fri, 10 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private pilot request — Montclair Health

Hi Olivia — great to meet you and thanks for the details. Quick answers up front:

- Yes — we can run the pilot inside a customer-managed VPC or an on-prem air-gapped environment. We’ll send a short ops checklist for network/ports and artifact transfer.
- For SOC2/PCI evidence: thanks for the questionnaire — Marcus (SE) will triage and pull the preflight artifacts we can share. We’ll clearly mark anything that requires NDAs or a secure file transfer.
- Proposed slot: Tue Oct 20, 10:00–11:00 AM ET for the technical walkthrough, followed by a shorter CIO-facing summary on Thu Oct 22, 11:00–11:30 AM ET. If those work I’ll have Vivek send official invites.

Pre-demo asks:
- Can you confirm whether your network team allows outbound TLS to our control-plane endpoints (we’ll provide FQDNs)? If not, we’ll outline the local-only ops flow.
- Please upload any anonymized sample request payloads to the Drive link below so Marcus can test model behavior under your sequence lengths.

I attached a short demo ops agenda and a checklist below. Marcus — can you confirm what evidence we can provide ahead of the call and whether we need to request an elevated NDA?

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.in | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood-demo-ops-agenda.pdf (6 KB, PDF)
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xq-demo-evidence
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.in>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@montclairhealth.org>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.in>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.in>, IT Security <itsec@montclairhealth.org>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private pilot request — Montclair Health

Hi Olivia — Marcus here. I reviewed the questionnaire you attached. Quick notes:

- We can provide an evidence snapshot containing architecture diagrams, network port list, and a redacted SOC2 attestation excerpt. Anything marked as legal-only (contracts/SLA clauses) will require your procurement/legal handshake first.
- For PCI-specific items we’ll need to follow a secure upload route — if your team can provide a secure SFTP endpoint or an encrypted Drive folder with requester access, we’ll drop what we can there.
- Regarding the tech walkthrough timing: I’m blocked in the morning of Oct 20 on back-to-back calls. Would you be open to moving the technical walkthrough to Oct 21, 10:00–11:00 AM ET? That would still allow a brief leadership summary on Oct 22 as discussed.

I’ve attached a short "what we can share pre-demo" checklist and flagged a handful of items that usually require an enterprise agreement. If you’d like to accelerate any legal pieces I can introduce our contracts lead.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.in

Attachment: montclair-evidence-checklist.pdf (9 KB, PDF)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.in>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@montclairhealth.org>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.in>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.in>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private pilot request — Montclair Health

Thanks Olivia — appreciate the flexibility. Confirming the updated schedule:

- Tech walkthrough: Wed Oct 21, 10:00–11:00 AM ET (Zoom link to follow)
- CIO summary: Thu Oct 22, 11:00–11:30 AM ET (short sync)

I’ve created the calendar invite and attached the .ics; Marcus and Soojin will join the tech call and Marcus will lead the evidence review. Action items for Montclair:

1) Please provision a secure upload (SFTP or encrypted Drive) and drop the questionnaire and a small sample payload by EOD Tue Oct 20.
2) Confirm whether your network team can allow outbound TLS to control-plane.redwood.in so we can avoid an air-gap fallback.

If anything changes I’ll update the invites. Looking forward — Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
SDR, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.in | (650) 555-0123
